test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"worst."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank needs a word that describes a negative comparison with the first option.
 
• **"Worse"** is the best fit as it is the opposite of **"better,"** which is the first option.
 
• We need to use the superlative degree in the blank.
 
• The superlative degree of comparison is mainly used to show which of the nouns in a particular context has the greatest or least degree of the quality mentioned.
 
• It is the highest degree of comparison and is used to compare three or more nouns or pronouns.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

The Grim Reaper seems to have appeared__ in Europe during the 14th century. It was during this time that Europe was dealing with what was then the world’s __**worst**__ pandemic, the Black Death, believed to be the result of the plague. It is estimated that about one-third of Europe’s entire population ______ (3) ______ as a result of the pandemic, with some areas of the continent suffering far greater losses than others. The original outbreak of the plague occurred during 1347–51, and outbreaks then ______ (4) ______ several other times after that. So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they ______ (5) ______ an image to represent it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Better: **Comparative degree of the word** "Good."**
 
• **Worse: **Comparative degree of the word "Bad."
 
• **Best: **Superlative degree of the word "Good."
